name: Cartvai – Ecommerce Checkout and Funnel
author: cartvai

sections.description:
Cartvai is a lightweight and conversion-focused ecommerce checkout and sales funnel plugin for WordPress. It helps businesses create streamlined checkout experiences, manage orders, and build sales funnels designed to turn visitors into customers.

Create simple one-page checkout experiences, collect customer information, manage orders, and optimize the buying journey from a single, easy-to-use system.

Cartvai is suitable for physical products, digital products, services, courses, and Cash on Delivery (COD) businesses.

Features

  • Standalone funnel system (No WooCommerce required)
  • Unlimited products
  • Unlimited sales funnels
  • One-page checkout experience
  • Built-in Cash on Delivery (COD) checkout
  • Product categories
  • Product management
  • Funnel management
  • Order management
  • Customer management
  • Sales analytics dashboard
  • Custom order statuses
  • CSV order export
  • Shortcode-based funnel embedding
  • Mobile-friendly checkout
  • Fast and lightweight
  • Developer-friendly hooks and filters
  • Clean database architecture
  • Page builder compatible
  • Translation ready

Perfect For

  • Single product businesses
  • Cash on Delivery stores
  • Landing pages
  • Facebook & Google Ads campaigns
  • Affiliate marketing
  • Product launches
  • Local businesses
  • Digital products
  • Physical products
  • Agencies building sales funnels for clients

Why Cartvai – Ecommerce Checkout and Funnel?

Traditional eCommerce plugins often include hundreds of features that many businesses never use.

Cartvai – Ecommerce Checkout and Funnel focuses only on what matters most:

  • Higher conversion rates
  • Faster checkout
  • Simple management
  • Better performance
  • Cleaner user experience

Everything is optimized around selling products through dedicated funnels instead of traditional online stores.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Cartvai – Ecommerce Checkout and Funnel from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create one or more product categories (optional).
  5. Create your products.
  6. Create a sales funnel.
  7. Add products to the funnel.
  8. Place the generated shortcode on any page or landing page.
  9. Start receiving customer orders.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

No. Cartvai – Ecommerce Checkout and Funnel is completely independent and does not require WooCommerce.

What payment methods are supported?

Version 0.1 focuses on Cash on Delivery (COD), making it ideal for businesses selling physical products.

Can I create multiple funnels?

Yes. You can create unlimited sales funnels.

Can I sell multiple products?

Yes. There is no limit to the number of products you can create.

Does it include order management?

Yes. Orders are stored inside your WordPress website with custom statuses and customer information.

Can I export orders?

Yes. Orders can be exported as CSV.

Does it include analytics?

Yes. The built-in dashboard provides sales reports, revenue, order statistics, and other business insights.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes. Funnels are embedded using shortcodes, making them compatible with most WordPress page builders.
